title: Foundation, API, generation, and integration
instructions: Agent 1 is the lead and owns the bulk of the build. Build the Next.js App Router/TypeScript/Tailwind foundation, shared contracts, durable local run state, generation, and start/status/approve/cancel API. Agent 2 owns the orchestration loop in src/lib/orchestrator/; integrate it without competing edits. Integrate other agents' work. Keep real provider execution behind explicit setup; label fixtures. Enforce proposal-specific approval before provisioning, cancellation, duplicate request protection, a small attempt cap, one sandbox at a time, and truthful measured evidence. Only the coordinator installs dependencies and runs live provider operations. Purchases require explicit concrete approval. No commits or branch changes unless requested. Verify a narrow smoke flow and report blockers. Use the coordination service for messages and task handoffs.
